run_update_build_version: run the script to generate a version info output file from a spirv-tools directory
create_deduce_software_version: create a call to deduce_software_version to parse the version from a CHANGES file in a directory
create_describe_git: create a call to describe to get git HEAD version info from a directory
create_mkdir_p: create a call to mkdir_p to recursively create a directory and all its ancestors
create_command_output: create a call to command_output to run a subprocess command in a given directory
